supporting_pages.title: "Searching for FHIR resources \_|\_ Cloud Healthcare API \_|\_ Google Cloud\
evidence_snippets: Using the FHIR viewer The FHIR viewer is a page in the Google Cloud console that lets you search for and view the contents of FHIR resources .
You can search for FHIR resources in the Cloud Healthcare API in the following ways: Using the FHIR viewer in the Google Cloud console.
To search for resources in a FHIR store, complete the following steps: In the Google Cloud console, go to the FHIR viewer page.
